name: Sweetbitter
description: Shortly after arriving in New York City, 22-year-old Tess lands a job at a celebrated downtown restaurant. Swiftly introduced to the world of drugs, alcohol, love, lust, dive bars, and fine dining, she learns to navigate the chaotically alluring, yet punishing life she has stumbled upon.

videos.title: Salt
videos.overview: 22-year-old Tess moves to New York City, without friends or a specific ambition. After an interview at one of the best restaurants, she's invited to train. She attempts to keep up while observing her new coworkers.

videos.title: Now Your Tongue is Coded
videos.overview: When Tess forgets her wallet at the restaurant, she goes back to discover what happens after-hours: shift drinks. Simone teaches her about the coding of our tongues, leading Tess to become even more enthralled by Simone.

videos.title: Everyone Is Soigné
videos.overview: Tess meets Serena, an alumna of the restaurant who married one of their wealthiest guests. Serena and Simone were best friends. To Tess, Serena has the perfect life. Simone teaches Tess not to believe everything she sees.

videos.title: Simone's
videos.overview: Tess has a day off and decides to go to Simone's apartment unannounced; after Simone invites Tess into her world, her abrupt expulsion leaves Tess lonelier than ever.

videos.title: Weird Night
videos.overview: Tess arrives at the restaurant in high spirits, but soon realizes this is a night where everything will go wrong. Tess and Sasha embark on a drug-fueled night of adventure to burn off stress until the night takes a turn.

videos.title: It's Mine
videos.overview: After partying until sunrise, Tess is not in an ideal state for her exam; the day’s events make her question if it is really worth it.

videos.title: The Pork Special
videos.overview: Howard takes his staff to learn where their food comes from. Tess learns information that makes her wonder whom she can trust.

videos.title: Equifax & Experian
videos.overview: Tess’ bad credit score reveals something about her past, and he gang tries to help. Sasha is accused when Santos’ new shoes go missing.

videos.title: Last of the Season
videos.overview: Maddie Glover, the restaurant's head chef, returns for a surprise menu tasting. Tess connects with a handsome guest. Will receives a surprising offer.

videos.title: Sec or Demi-Sec
videos.overview: Tess has a mortifying sexual encounter with Omar. Sasha receives terrible news from home. A table makes a racist comment to Heather.

videos.title: Entropy
videos.overview: There's a retaliation when Howard decides to restructure the restaurant's tip structure. Tess learns more about Simone and gets closer to Jake.

videos.title: Truffles and Champagne
videos.overview: Simone's ex-husband shows up in the restaurant and dredges up old feelings. Tess tries to figure out what, and whom, she really wants.

videos.title: Peach Treats
videos.overview: Tess and Jake take their relationship to the next level, causing tension with Simone. Ari feels abandoned. Will uses his power for a questionable purpose.

videos.title: Bodega Cat
videos.overview: Tess learns the truth about Jake and Simone's past. She forms a plan to get everything she wants in the restaurant.
